items.claim: 24.576 MHz (40.69 ns) is a plan clock candidate: 512 clocks per 48 kHz frame, ~5.33 clocks per operator over 96 operator states.

Frame budget: 16 notes x 6 operators x 48 kHz = 4.608M operator evaluations/s; 512/256 clocks per frame at 24.576/12.288 MHz.

The 7t library has no enable flop; an enable-written state bit costs dffq_1 + mux2_1 = 92.20 um2 before any logic touches it.

Register-state cost anchors: dffq_1 63.66 um2/flop; replicated state bit ~118 um2/bit all-in; FIFO storage 120 um2/bit; a measured register file (drum_regs) landed at 139.9 um2/bit once decode/enable overhead landed.

items.claim: No usable large (>512 B) on-chip SRAM with timing views exists on this PDK today. Case-table ROMs synthesize to logic at ~1.9-2.2 um2 per stored bit, cheaper per bit than a flop; relevant to DX7 sine/exp table representation.
